title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature matters because it enables handling of JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, improving the framework's usability and flexibility. It will parse the request body and make it available to route handlers. This will simplify development of RESTful APIs and other applications that rely on request body data
acceptance: Request body is correctly parsed and available to route handlers for JSON and URL-encoded requests, with proper error handling for invalid JSON
reason: This feature is a key requirement for many web applications and will significantly enhance the framework's capabilities and appeal to developers
